verses.gurmukhi: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਹੋਮ ਜਗ ਨਈਵੇਦ ਕਰੋੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: jap tap sa(n)jam lakh lakh hom jag nieevedh karoRee|

en.bdb: Millions of rituals of recitation, penances, continence, burnt offerings and crores of oblations are there.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਰਤ ਨੇਮ ਸੰਜਮ ਘਣੇ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਲਖ ਤੰਦੁ ਮਰੋੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: varat nem sa(n)jam ghane karam dharam lakh ta(n)dh maroRee|

en.bdb: Fasts, rules, controls, activities are many but they all are like a weak thread.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੀਰਥ ਪੁਰਬ ਸੰਜੋਗ ਲਖ ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨੁ ਉਪਕਾਰ ਨ ਓੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: teerath purab sa(n)jog lakh pu(n)n dhaan upakaar na oRee|

en.bdb: Many are pilgrimage centres, anniversaries, and millions of virtuous acts, charities and altruism's.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵੀ ਦੇਵ ਸਰੇਵਣੇ ਵਰ ਸਰਾਪ ਲਖ ਜੋੜ ਵਿਛੋੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: dhevee dhev sarevane var saraap lakh joR vichhoRee|

en.bdb: Millions kinds of worship of gods and goddesses, combinations, detractions, boons, curses are there.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸਨ ਵਰਨ ਅਵਰਨ ਲਖ ਪੂਜਾ ਅਰਚਾ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੋੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: dharasan varan avaran lakh poojaa arachaa ba(n)dhan toRee|

en.bdb: Many philosophies, varnas, non-varnas and many are the persons who do not bother about the (unnecessary) brands of lakhs of worships and oblations.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੋਕ ਵੇਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਿਆਨ ਲਖ ਜੋਗ ਭੋਗ ਲਖ ਝਾੜਿ ਪਛੋੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: lok vedh gun giaan lakh jog bhog lakh jhaaR pachhoRee|

en.bdb: Many are the means of public behaviour, virtues, renunciation, indulgence and other covering devices;

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚਹੁ ਓਰੈ ਸਭ ਕਿਹੁ ਲਖ ਸਿਆਣਪ ਸੱਭਾ ਥੋੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: sachahu orai sabh kih lakh siaanap sa'bhaa thoRee|

en.bdb: But all these are craftsmanship's remain away from the truth; they cannot touch it.
Higher than truth is truthful living.
